title: Product Map: capability grouping
description: User story under REQ-170. a product reader thinking in capabilities rather than technical shape a capability grouping that reads capability:<slug> entries from REQ.tags[] and buckets requirements per capability
asA: a product reader thinking in capabilities rather than technical shape
iWant: a capability grouping that reads capability:<slug> entries from REQ.tags[] and buckets requirements per capability
soThat: I can see the product as a set of capabilities and drill into each capability's REQs, stories and ACs

acceptanceCriteria.description: The capability grouping enumerates one bucket per distinct capability:<slug> value present on any REQ across the tree. A REQ carrying multiple capability tags appears under each. REQs whose tags carry no capability:<slug> entry are collected under an "Unclassified" bucket. Slugs are rendered as their kebab form in the heading; named capability buckets are ordered by REQ count desc, then alphabetically, and the Unclassified bucket is always pinned last.
